score.justification_pass1: The teacher provides incorrect mathematical content (claiming diagonal intersections form 90-degree angles when they don't in non-square rectangles), fails to engage with the student's actual confusion about the central angles versus corner angles, and simply tells answers rather than prompting reasoning, while the student's Turn 2 shows improved understanding of corner angles but receives misleading information about the central angles.
score.justification_pass2: While the teacher attempts to use real-world analogies (room corners, tic-tac-toe), the explanations are mathematically incorrect (claiming diagonal intersections form 90-degree angles in all rectangles) and fail to genuinely ground the abstract concept in accurate experiential understanding.
